tagline: Phillips Berry Patch In Guilford IN
description: Phillips Berry Patch grows Strawberries, Blueberries, and Blackberries in Guilford, IN. The farm is family-run, and its seasons run through spring and summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
